discrepancy_investigation_and_root_cause.error_type: Isolated documentation transcription error in markdown report
discrepancy_investigation_and_root_cause.affected_section: Section 3: Confusion Matrix & Diagnostic Metric Comparisons
discrepancy_investigation_and_root_cause.erroneous_claim: Cohort claimed as 46 MSS / 20 MSI with CM [[44, 2], [5, 15]] (Protocol 1) and [[43, 3], [5, 15]] (Protocol 2)
discrepancy_investigation_and_root_cause.root_cause: Manual transcription error where author mistakenly assumed 20 MSI cases (back-calculating from 75.00% sensitivity as 15 TP, 5 FN) and 46 MSS cases (calculating 44 TN for 59/66 accuracy), despite the raw JSON data (phase3_fp16_benchmark_data.json) and Table 4 of the very same report listing the true 50 MSS / 16 MSI cohort with 100% accuracy.
discrepancy_investigation_and_root_cause.reconciliation_action: Corrected phase3_2_numerical_drift_report.md Section 3 using exact recalculations from raw data; preserved original report backup at reports/mobile_deployment/phase3_2_numerical_drift_report_orig_backup.md and recorded audit history.
